limits: No public deployment or production security audit
Linux amd64/Chromium executed; other OS and browser engines not executed
Linear single changed range, not a minimal diff; complete eight-field snapshots included
Selectors: latest 100 plus current/live/chosen; older rows accessible by eight-row pages and exact API revision numbers
Memory-only uncertain restore receipt; refresh/close requires reviewing server history
Restore authority remains owner/draft; read/proposal compare only
Existing approved schedules retain pinned snapshot/time and can publish later
CI result for the exact submitted head must be observed separately; local evidence does not imply remote CI
Conservative 64 MiB JSON response budget may reject smaller actual comparisons; oversized legacy cover remains valid in backup import/export. No new full-history retrieval pagination.
